_llm_instructions: قم بتعبئة 'project_title' و 'date_prepared'، بالإضافة إلى خصائص 'value' لكل حقل في نموذج خطة إدارة الفوائد هذا بناءً على سياق المشروع.

Target Benefits.guidance: Expected tangible and intangible value to be gained.

Strategic Alignment.guidance: How the benefits align with the organization's strategic goals.

Timeframe.guidance: When the benefits are expected to be realized.

Metrics.guidance: How the benefits will be measured.

Risks.guidance: Risks associated with realizing the benefits.
